action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated (strength 0.98) with moderate seasonality and non-stationarity. Model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.173) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.851, only 2 independent groups), so a simple mean over the 5 most consistently-ranked models (all wavelet-transformed tree models) is the most robust combination. With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights or meta-models would overfit to noise. The leader's margin over the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable, confirming no strategy in the history is meaningfully better.
